It was believed that long before the arrival of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] around [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]], the planet's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]], the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], rallied for '''war''' against [[Bursa/Legends|bursas]], a violent<ref name="GB" /> semi-sentient<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Species/Legends|species]] that attacked Gungan settlements on a regular basis.<ref name="GB" /> To combat the threat, the Gungans developed military technology<ref name="Card">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|cardname=Gungan Hunter}}</ref> and created a [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] that supposedly drove the bursas to [[Death/Legends|extinction]].<ref name="GB" /> Gungan society became more militaristic and tribal as a result of the war with the bursas,<ref name="TEA" /> and they continued to maintain the Gungan Grand Army in the following years, even during peacetime. Bursas still played a role in the [[War of the Gungan tribes|war]] between the Gungan tribes, which ended<ref name="GB" /> in 3000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> and they were later captured and bred for export by members of the [[Amaran/Legends|Amaran]] species.<ref name="Wild">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Early during the writing of the ''Essential Guide to Episode I'', I came across a George Lucas reference that the Gungans may have kept an army due to a past conflict with "bear-like creatures."|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|danwallace|34|Lostwords: The Essential Guide to Episode I}}</ref>}}
[[File:BursaConceptArt.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Concept art of Gungans fighting a bursa by Robin Pronovost]]
The war between the Gungans and the bursas was first mentioned in the Gungan DataBank entry in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="GB" /> The concept for the war was originated by<ref name="Blog" /> ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator<ref name="Aliens2">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[George Lucas]], who described the Gungan Grand Army as being created to fight [[Bear/Legends|bear]]-like creatures. Author [[Daniel Wallace]] came across Lucas's concept and planned to expand upon it in ''[[The Essential Guide to Episode I]]'', requesting artist [[Robin Pronovost]] to design a creature that became the bursas, although the guide was ultimately cancelled.<ref name="Blog" /> In a blog post in which they shared concept art of a bursa drawn in [[2000]], Pronovost offered the unofficial explanation that the bursas were driven to extinction by the Gungans, but were preserved by a breeding program established by the Amarans.<ref name="Blog2">{{WebCite|url=https://flyingarmadillo.com/amarans-backstory-and-history|text=Amarans Backstory and History|author=[[Robin Pronovost|Pronovost, Robin]]|date=2010-01-31|work=Art by Robin Pronovost|archivedate=20210123114514}}</ref>

The [[2001]] reference book [[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]<ref name="Aliens">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> contradicted ''Galactic Battlegrounds''<ref name="GB" /> by stating that the Gungan Grand Army was formed in a conflict with unknown invaders of Naboo in their early history,<ref name="Aliens" /> and [[2006]]'s [[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species (book)|''The New Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]<ref name="Aliens2" /> stated that the conflict took place nearly 100 years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Aliens" /> In another contradiction, the [[2002]] [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 47|forty-seventh]] issue of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' magazine stated that the Gungan Grand Army was formed by united factions after the war between the Gungan tribes.<ref name="Fact">{{FactFile|47|GUN 5-6|Gungan Energy Shield}}</ref> This article uses sources that state that the war against the bursas caused the formation of the Gungan Grand Army, including ''Galactic Battlegrounds'',<ref name="GB" /> [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'',<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|I|376|Gungan Grand Army}}</ref> and [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="TEA" />
